name: Skinless Oven-Roasted Chicken Breast with Mashed Potatoes
whyItWorks: While famous for fried chicken, requesting oven-roasted skinless chicken breast paired with peeled, creamy mashed potatoes provides top-quality lean protein and gut-soothing starch with zero heavy frying fat.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Specify roasted chicken breast rather than fried chicken. Remove skin and enjoy with peeled mashed potatoes and light chicken gravy.
